abstract: While recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis have substantially improved speech quality and modeling flexibility, the development of lightweight and computationally efficient systems remains comparatively underexplored. We present LeanTTS, a bilingual complete synthesis stack that supports two complementary regimes: reference-prompt zero-shot cloning for unseen speakers and token-conditioned customization for recurring voices. LeanTTS combines a compact Mandarin polyphone front end, a structurally compressed flow-matching acoustic model, and a lightweight Vocos decoder with four-step MeanFlow generation. The resulting system contains 18.9M learned parameters, 86.12% fewer than the 136.2M-parameter ZipVoice-Vocos pipeline. On Seed-TTS-Eval, its zero-shot mode obtains 2.02 CER/62.3 SIM on Mandarin and 2.32 WER/48.3 SIM on English, exposing the quality-size trade-off under aggressive compression. With token-conditioned customized voices, the same system reaches 1.57 CER/77.2 SIM on Mandarin and 1.93 WER/76.6 SIM on English, with UTMOS scores of 3.03 and 4.33, respectively. It further achieves mean/P90 CPU RTFs of 0.049/0.061, establishing a sub-20M operating point for bilingual personalization and real-time CPU deployment. Audio demos are available at https://github.com/notlu/leantts.

oneSentenceThesis: LeanTTS 把中文发音前端、流匹配声学模型和 Vocos 声码器一起压缩到 18.9M 参数，用参考音频做零样本克隆、用说话人标签做固定音色定制，在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上验证了质量、相似度和 CPU 实时率之间的取舍。
originalTitle: LeanTTS: Efficient Full-Stack Bilingual TTS for Zero-Shot Cloning and Voice Customization
readerTitle: LeanTTS：不到 20M 参数如何同时做零样本克隆和固定音色定制
